features.name: Web App for Expense Agent
features.description: A dedicated web application exclusive to the expense agent, allowing employees who are not Business Central users to create, review, and submit expenses and expense reports directly.

features.name: AI Receipt Extraction
features.description: The expense agent uses AI to automatically extract relevant information from uploaded receipts including numbers, dates, and itemizations, categorizing them appropriately.
caveats: OCR capabilities for various receipt types

features.name: Automatic Expense Report Creation
features.description: When an expense passes initial validation tests, it is automatically added to a default expense report without requiring manual report creation.

features.name: Manual Expense Correction
features.description: Users can manually correct AI-detected issues, add notes such as marking meetings as customer meetings, and update expense details before submission.

features.name: Automatic Currency Conversion
features.description: The web app automatically detects receipt currencies and converts amounts to the user's local currency for display and processing.

features.name: Exception Handling and Details Display
features.description: When AI extraction encounters issues or missing details, the system displays a summary for user review and correction before reprocessing the workflow.

features.name: Manual Expense Grouping
features.description: Users can manually drag and drop receipts between expense reports or manually assign receipts to specific reports when automatic grouping is not desired.
caveats: Automatic grouping described as somewhat simple

features.name: Expense Submission for Approval
features.description: Once an expense report is complete and verified, users can submit it for approval, triggering notifications to approvers who review and process approvals in the same web app.

features.name: Approver Portal
features.description: Finance and approvers can use the same web app to review submitted expense reports with full details and either approve or request corrections.
